comments.author: Meng Meng
comments.body: To get this card you must go to Amsterdam(that is where I did it)and take a prequest where you have to take a translated note from Amsterdam to Hamburg. After you do that quest you will get another quest(Relay the will of the forefathers). For this quest you go from Amsterdam to Lisbon, to Marseille, and then Naples where you finish the quest. You then turn in and you receive the card to get this job.
